# Laravel Backend Conventions

Stack: Laravel 13, PHP 8.3+, Inertia (server side), Fortify, Pest 4, Larastan (PHPStan), Pint (`laravel` preset).

## Controllers & Inertia
- Return typed `Inertia\Response` from `Inertia::render('PageName', [...])`. The page name maps to a component under `resources/js/pages/`.
- Prefer single-action invokable controllers (`public function __invoke(Request $request): Response`) for single-purpose endpoints.
- Keep controllers thin: validate with Form Requests, shape response payloads inline or via mapping, push domain logic into Actions/models.
- Always add parameter and return type declarations.

## Validation
- Use dedicated Form Requests in `app/Http/Requests/` (e.g. `AnnouncementRequest`). Implement `authorize()` and `rules()` with array-of-rules syntax (`['required', 'string', 'max:255']`).
- Override `validated()` to normalize/cast payloads when needed (see existing requests).

## Bilingual content
- User-facing content is bilingual: `en` (English) and `dv` (Dhivehi). Validate and store both, e.g. `title.en` required, `title.dv` nullable; default missing `dv` to `''`.

## Models & queries
- Start queries with `Model::query()->...` and use arrow functions for closures (`fn ($q) => ...`).
- Reuse existing patterns in `app/` — Enums (`app/Enums`), Data objects (`app/Data`), Concerns (`app/Concerns`), Policies (`app/Policies`).

## Quality gates (run before considering work done)
- `composer lint` (Pint) formats PHP; do not hand-format against the `laravel` preset.
- `composer types:check` runs PHPStan/Larastan — code must pass with no new errors.
- `php artisan test` (Pest) — add/adjust tests in `tests/Feature` or `tests/Unit` for behavior changes.
- `composer test` runs lint + types + tests together.

## Routes
- Route files live in `routes/`. Frontend consumes typed helpers generated by Laravel Wayfinder — do not hardcode URLs in PHP that the frontend must mirror.
